# Active IJDS Manuscript

The single active manuscript is `CRPTO_ijds.qmd`, with online supplement
`supplement_ijds.qmd`. The anonymous INFORMS TeX in
`submission/CRPTO_ijds_submission.tex` is generated from the QMD and must not be
edited directly.

The active authorities are:

- claim registry: `../docs/research/active_claims_2026-07-14.md`;
- source registry: `../configs/ijds_active_evidence_sources.yaml`;
- executable claim ledger: `../configs/ijds_claim_ledger.yaml`; and
- paper-facing evidence manifest:
  `../reports/crpto/ijds_binary_geometry_frontier_v4_evidence.json`.

The study uses the exhaustive 640,543-loan eligible design. The primary OOT
panel has 376,890 candidates, including 12,076 outcomes unresolved at the
reconstructed cutoff. Five frozen learner specifications provide coverage
controls; only the primary CatBoost score enters portfolio optimization. The
paper reports all declared windows, rulers, coordinates, sensitivities, and
registered comparator supports. It selects no learner, window, gamma, ruler,
coordinate, cap, comparator, or policy and makes no causal, selected-set,
prospective, or deployment claim.

Compact-v7, pool93, A1--A40, selected-policy, external-transfer, and historical
V1--V3 materials are provenance only and do not support the active manuscript.

# Build and Validation

```powershell
just submission-build
just ijds-active-check
just submission-check
```

The first command regenerates the active aggregate evidence and all reviewer
documents. The latter commands verify scientific, lineage, hash, anonymity,
compilation, and PDF contracts without promoting a result or policy.
